load_ply_mesh: load verts and faces from a PLY file using load_ply function
save_ply_mesh: save a mesh with verts and faces to a PLY file using save_ply function
read_mesh_ply_format: read a PLY file into a PyTorch3D Meshes object using MeshPlyFormat.read method
save_mesh_ply_format: save a PyTorch3D Meshes object to a PLY file using MeshPlyFormat.save method
load_pointcloud_ply: load a point cloud from a PLY file using PointcloudPlyFormat.read method
